world_news.headline: Human torso found in sofa in Sydney bushland prompts homicide investigation
world_news.summary:
Police called to Lane Cove North on Wednesday after sofa found containing human torso believed to be that of adult man

New South Wales police have launched a homicide investigation after a human torso was found in bushland on Sydney’s lower north shore.

Police were called to Lane Cove North about 2.30pm on Wednesday after reports of human remains.

world_news.headline: Australian states could sue tobacco companies for billions in healthcare costs under proposal
world_news.summary:
Exclusive: Former barrister who helped legally establish that secondhand smoke causes lung cancer argues states could seek up to $50bn in compensation

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Australian state governments could sue tobacco companies for billions in public hospital and healthcare costs, under a proposal developed by a former barrister who helped legally establish that secondhand smoke causes lung cancer.

The South Australian government is formally seeking advice on the proposal, while other states are reviewing it.
